review.resolution: The single candidate has_subtype_by_id is a displacement-only false positive. Both binaries shift the player index by seven, start the element index at five, and load the subtype and added_forced fields using the table base minus 40 and 36 respectively. No wrong-global source edit is justified.
additional_small_diff_spot_checks: can_activate_basic_equipment: arithmetic versus logical shift followed by masking to eight bits gives the same stored color requirement.
miara_trigger: the source already rejects amount below one; native test/return placement alone does not justify a source change.
card_trench_gorger: native explicit count four is on the four-lands/player-one exit path; the reconstructed counter already has that value on that path.
review.score_regressions: Fourteen functions score lower after naming/alignment changes and the preceding two source edits, without losing an exact match. The scores remain discovery signals; the pass does not certify every residual block as equivalent.
